swsh12-001.name: Venonat
swsh12-001.description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

swsh12-002.name: Venomoth
swsh12-002.description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

attacks.name: Miracle Powder

swsh12-003.name: Spinarak
swsh12-003.description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

swsh12-004.name: Ariados
swsh12-004.description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

swsh12-005.name: Sunkern
swsh12-005.description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

swsh12-006.name: Sunflora
swsh12-006.description: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

attacks.name: Noble Light

attacks.name: Regal Blender

attacks.name: Star Winder

swsh12-009.name: Petilil
swsh12-009.description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

swsh12-010.name: Hisuian Lilligant
swsh12-010.description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

attacks.name: Swelling Scent
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Grass Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh12-011.name: Foongus
swsh12-011.description: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

swsh12-012.name: Amoonguss
swsh12-012.description: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

swsh12-013.name: Durant

swsh12-014.name: Virizion

swsh12-016.name: Radiant Tsareena

swsh12-017.name: Vulpix

swsh12-020.name: Arcanine

swsh12-021.name: Ponyta

swsh12-031.name: Torracat
